4.name: L
4.text: I was curious, are you still taking those online classes? You know, for that college?

8.name: L
8.text: Don’t you think that’s kind of a waste of time?

10.name: L
10.text: It’s just that none of my friends who went to college are actually doing very well these days.

11.name: L
11.text: They spent all that time studying and working hard, but it wasn’t worth it at the end.

12.name: L
12.text: They regretted all the time they could have spent working and making friends.

13.name: L
13.text: I think that sounds really bad.

16.name: L
16.text: I’ll support you no matter what you choose to do, okay?

17.name: L
17.text: I’m sure you know what you’re doing very well!
